battle.name: 第七次俄土戰爭
battle.theater: 魯塞（保加利亞多瑙河下游）
battle.brief: 第七次俄土戰爭是中文維基「戰爭列表」中的俄羅斯帝國與鄂圖魯帝國戰爭，1806年爆發，延至1812年，交戰重點在多瑙河下游、黑海北岸及高加索。英國陸軍的燧發槍（Flintlock musket）於1710年服役，屬當時步兵火器體系，也是步兵編制中的通用火器，並用於野戰。

kit.name: 燧發槍
kit.history: 擊錘打火比火繩穩。線性列陣的射速和精度都靠它撐著。

countries: 1806年開戰時，真正承擔戰役的兩個主體是俄羅斯帝國與奧斯曼帝國。俄方由沙皇亞歷山大一世主持政策，遠征軍依軍團、師、旅與團的編制由將領率領；奧方則先後面對塞利姆三世、穆斯塔法四世與馬哈茂德二世。摩爾多瓦與瓦拉幾亞在法律上仍屬奧斯曼的附屬公國，但俄軍占領兩地並扶植親俄的督軍，因此不能把兩地另算成獨立交錯國。法國沒有向奧軍派出與俄軍相當的大批遠征部隊，主要提供外交支持、軍事顧問及部分援助，並利用俄土矛盾維持戰略空間；英國與瑞典則在初期援助俄方。1807年《提爾西特和約》後，普魯士與俄國的處境改變，同盟關係成為前線之外的變數。戰爭期間的外交陣營並非固定，兩位沙皇與蘇丹更替，以及巴黎、倫敦和北歐的戰略，都會改變前線可調用的資源。
countriesEn: When the war began in 1806, the two principal belligerents were the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire. Russia’s policy was directed by Tsar Alexander I, while its expeditionary forces were commanded through a hierarchy of army corps, divisions, brigades, and regiments. The Ottoman side passed through Selim III, Mustafa IV, and Mahmud II. Moldavia and Wallachia remained legally Ottoman principalities, but Russian troops occupied them and supported pro-Russian hospodars, so they should not be counted as independent belligerents. France did not deploy an expeditionary force comparable to the Russian army; it provided diplomatic backing, military advisers, and limited assistance while exploiting the Russo-Ottoman rivalry. Britain and Sweden initially assisted Russia. After the Treaty of Tilsit in 1807, the position of Prussia and Russia changed, making alliance relations another variable outside the front. The diplomatic alignment did not remain fixed. Changes of rulers in Russia and the Ottoman Empire, together with strategies pursued in Paris, London, and northern Europe, altered the resources available to the combatants.
people: 前線的人事安排顯示，這場戰爭同時受到最高政治與前線指揮的牽制。亞歷山大一世把收復比薩拉比亞及影響多瑙河兩岸列為政策目標，庫圖佐夫於1806年負責摩爾多瓦方向的俄軍；1807年拉姆尼庫薩拉特戰役中，巴格拉季昂率前衛，米洛拉多維奇指揮側翼與騎兵協同，庫圖佐夫則負責全軍主攻。奧軍統帥優素福帕夏在戰敗後失去主動權。俄軍沒有乘勝長驅直取君士坦丁堡，因前線距離、冬季補給與政治授權均有顧慮，庫圖佐夫轉而在斯洛博齊亞一帶迫使奧方談判。塞利姆三世提拔的尼扎姆－傑迪德新軍與舊有禁衛軍存在矛盾；1807年禁衛軍政變迫使塞利姆退位，穆斯塔法四世及後來的馬哈茂德二世因而改用更保守的用人方式。1809年接管多瑙河下游的尼古拉·卡門斯基以果斷進取聞名，但遠征過度、追擊不足及軍隊患病削弱其成果；1811年馬爾科夫攻取魯塞後，卡門斯基因病與指揮爭議被庫圖佐夫接替。後者同時進行有限攻勢與外交交涉，使軍事壓力最終轉化為可簽署的停戰條件。
peopleEn: The command arrangements show how the war was shaped by both high politics and battlefield leadership. Alexander I made the recovery of Bessarabia and influence across the Danube central to Russian policy. In 1806, Kutuzov commanded the Russian army operating from Moldavia. At the Battle of Râmnicu Sărat in 1807, Bagration led the advance guard, Miloradovich coordinated the flank and cavalry, and Kutuzov directed the main attack. The Ottoman commander Yusuf Pasha lost initiative after the defeat. The Russians did not pursue all the way to Constantinople, because distance, winter supply, and the limits of political authorization complicated further advance; Kutuzov instead pressed the Ottomans toward negotiations around Slobozia. Selim III’s Nizam-i Cedid troops were already in conflict with the older Janissary establishment. A Janissary coup deposed Selim in 1807, and Mustafa IV and the later Mahmud II consequently relied on more conservative personnel policies. Nikolay Kamensky, who took charge of the lower Danube in 1809, was known for aggressive decisions, but overextended operations, incomplete pursuit, and disease weakened his results. After Markov occupied Ruse in 1811, Kamensky was replaced by Kutuzov because of illness and command disputes. Kutuzov combined limited offensive operations with diplomatic contacts, turning military pressure into negotiable armistice terms.
kits: 交戰雙方的裝備仍以火繩時代晚期的火槍和前裝滑膛炮為核心。俄軍步兵使用1796式燧發滑膛步槍，槍身配刺刀，步騎兵則有1796式龍騎軍彎刀；野戰炮隊使用1800式六磅青銅前裝滑膛野戰炮，以及同類十二磅野戰炮，炮彈為實心球形彈，發射依靠黑火藥。俄軍步兵的常用攜彈量為每人約六十發，後備彈藥由營屬車隊補充，炮隊則以炮架前車、彈藥車和後車分載備彈。奧斯曼常備步兵使用燧發滑膛火槍，禁衛軍與各地方部隊另配基利吉彎刀、亞達干短刀及少量斧兵器；其青銅前裝滑膛炮常見六磅、十二磅、十八磅與二十四磅等口徑，規格雖不如俄軍整齊，仍能形成有效火力。兩軍都沒有線膛槍或爆炸式炮彈。攻城時使用臼炮、柴束、籬笆、浮橋和舟艇，後勤則依靠牛車、糧秣車、馬匹飼料以及多瑙河船運。俄軍從普魯特河與德涅斯特河方向取得補給，奧軍則以錫利斯特拉、魯塞等要塞維持前線供應。冬季裝備不足、運河與道路淤塞，以及霍亂樣的腹瀉與斑疹病，使遠征戰的損失遠超單純作戰所能解釋的範圍。
kitsEn: The equipment of both sides remained centered on late flintlock muskets and muzzle-loading smoothbore artillery. Russian infantry used the Model 1796 flintlock smoothbore musket with a bayonet, while cavalry included the Model 1796 dragoon sabre. The Russian artillery deployed the Model 1800 six-pounder bronze smoothbore field gun and field guns of the same general type at twelve-pounder weight. Their ammunition consisted of solid round shot fired with black powder. A common Russian infantry load was approximately sixty rounds per man, with reserve ammunition carried by battalion trains; artillery batteries divided their rounds and supplies between limbers, ammunition wagons, and reserve wagons. Ottoman regular infantry used flintlock smoothbore muskets, while Janissary and provincial troops also carried kilij sabres, yataghan short swords, and a limited number of axes. Ottoman bronze smoothbore guns were available in six-, twelve-, eighteen-, and twenty-four-pounder weights. Their calibers were less standardized than the Russian system, but they could still deliver effective fire. Neither army possessed rifled weapons or explosive projectiles. Siege operations used mortars, fascines, gabions, pontoon bridges, and boats, while logistics depended on ox carts, supply wagons, animal fodder, and Danube transport. The Russians drew supplies through the Prut and Dniester, while the Ottomans sustained the front from fortresses such as Silistra and Ruse. Inadequate winter equipment, blocked roads and waterways, dysentery, and typhus made the cost of distant campaigning greater than combat alone would explain.
tactics: 1806年下半年，俄軍越過普魯特河，控制摩爾多瓦與瓦拉幾亞的重要城鎮和道路，奧軍則依托多瑙河沿岸要塞，以守點與小股出擊監視俄軍。1807年7月的《提爾西特和約》沒有終止前線：亞歷山大一世希望拿破侖迫使奧斯曼讓步，拿破侖則要求俄國停止有利於俄方的軍事優勢，雙方期待的結果正好相反。9月22日舊曆、10月4日新曆的拉姆尼庫薩拉特戰役中，常見估計為俄軍約一萬九千人、奧軍約一萬五千人，火炮數字的記載則互有出入。庫圖佐夫以正面射擊和密集步兵牽制奧軍中央，巴格拉季昂的前衛與米洛拉多維奇指揮的側翼、騎兵在陣地失衡時完成包圍，奧軍退路與營帳被切斷，通過拉姆尼庫薩拉特向北的退卻很快演成潰散。戰後俄軍推進至吉爾吉尤與斯洛博齊亞方向，控制渡河點及供應站，卻沒有把勝利擴張成遠征君士坦丁堡的行動；12月的斯洛博齊亞初步協議使大規模戰鬥暫停，談判則因邊界、附屬公國和黑海權利爭議而拖延。1808年戰端重開後，卡門斯基於1809年攻取比薩拉比亞的伊茲梅伊爾，沿希爾索瓦方向進入瓦拉幾亞，但遠距離補給、冬季降溫與疫病迫使俄軍收縮。1810年9月的巴丁戰役中，俄軍以步兵正面展開、炮兵集中射擊和騎兵攻擊營地，擊潰集結中的奧軍並取得南岸立足點；勝利後的追擊與後續補給仍受到速度、彈藥和指揮顧慮限制。1811年7月7日，馬爾科夫部隊攻入魯塞，俄軍隨即向錫利斯特拉推進並實施封鎖；卡門斯基因病由庫圖佐夫接替，軍隊在疾病、封鎖線與_permission缺乏之間無法迅速攻城。與此同時，奧方請求停戰，拿破侖準備侵入俄國也使俄方需要迅速解除多瑙河負擔。庫圖佐夫一面維持前線壓力，一面接待使節，最終以軍事成果換取可執行的撤軍與劃界安排。
tacticsEn: In the second half of 1806, Russian forces crossed the Prut, occupied important towns and roads in Moldavia and Wallachia, and confronted an Ottoman defensive system based on Danube fortresses, fixed posts, and small counter-raids. The Treaty of Tilsit in July 1807 did not end the fighting on this front. Alexander I expected Napoleon to compel Ottoman concessions, while Napoleon expected Russia to surrender its military advantage; the two expectations were directly opposed. At the Battle of Râmnicu Sărat, fought on 22 September Old Style and 4 October New Style, common estimates place the Russian army near 19,000 men and the Ottoman force near 15,000, although artillery figures vary. Kutuzov used frontal infantry fire and massed formations to hold the Ottoman center. As the opposing line became unbalanced, Bagration’s advance guard and Miloradovich’s flank and cavalry completed the envelopment, cutting the Ottoman retreat and baggage route. The withdrawal northward quickly became a rout. The Russians then advanced toward Giurgiu and Slobozia, controlled crossing points and supply stations, but did not convert the victory into a march on Constantinople. A preliminary agreement at Slobozia in December halted major operations, although negotiations over borders, principalities, and Black Sea rights continued to drag on. Fighting resumed in 1808. In 1809, Kamensky captured Izmail in Bessarabia and advanced through Hirsova into Wallachia, but long supply lines, winter cold, and disease forced a contraction. At the Battle of Batin in September 1810, Russian infantry, concentrated artillery, and cavalry attacks broke an assembling Ottoman force and secured a foothold south of the Danube. The pace of pursuit and subsequent supply nevertheless remained constrained by speed, ammunition, and command concerns. On 7 July 1811, Markov’s troops entered Ruse, and the Russians advanced toward Silistra to blockade it. Kamensky was replaced by Kutuzov because of illness, while disease, blockade difficulties, and a lack of permission to conduct a full siege prevented a rapid reduction of the fortress. Ottoman peace overtures were accepted at the same time that Napoleon prepared to invade Russia, giving the Russian government a reason to end its Danube burden. Kutuzov maintained pressure while receiving envoys, eventually exchanging the military situation for an enforceable withdrawal and boundary settlement.
data: 第七次俄土戰爭通常指1806年至1812年，而不是1806年單獨的一年。主要節點依序是：1806年俄軍進入兩個多瑙河公國；1807年9月22日舊曆、10月4日新曆爆發拉姆尼庫薩拉特戰役；同年12月簽訂斯洛博齊亞初步協議；1808年談判破裂、戰事恢復；1809年俄軍攻取比薩拉比亞的伊茲梅伊爾；1810年9月19日發生巴丁戰役；1811年7月7日俄軍占領魯塞，隨後封鎖錫利斯特拉；1812年5月16日舊曆、5月28日新曆簽訂《布加勒斯特條約》。俄軍行軍主軸先由摩爾多瓦南下，經特爾古維利特方向指向拉姆尼庫薩拉特，再向吉爾吉尤與斯洛博齊亞延伸；卡門斯基的後續作戰則利用伊茲梅伊爾、希爾索瓦與巴丁一線，1811年再由魯塞逼近錫利斯特拉。俄軍步兵團以三個營為骨架，每營四連，師與旅負責把多個團組成可持續作戰的縱隊；奧軍除尼扎姆－傑迪德常備軍外，還有地方步兵、騎兵與執行追擊破壞任務的貝沙巴祖克，協同和指揮條件差異很大。拉姆尼庫薩拉特戰役的俄軍兵力常估約一萬九千人，奧軍約一萬五千人，但各來源採用的計算時點不同。俄軍步兵每人通常攜帶約六十發槍彈，營屬車隊攜行後備彈藥；炮兵依靠前車及彈藥車保持連續射擊。奧軍後勤以君士坦丁堡、錫利斯特拉、魯塞和多瑙河船運為軸心，軍隊宿營離補給點過遠時，炮彈和糧秣供應會迅速下降。浮橋、舟艇、牛車與沿岸倉儲決定渡河與追擊速度；冰雪、春季泥濘和疫病則使計畫中的攻勢常常停滯。現存資料足以判定主要勝負、俘獲和撤退方向，卻不能支持一個可信而一致的雙方總傷亡數字。
dataEn: The Seventh Russo-Turkish War is conventionally dated from 1806 to 1812 rather than being confined to a single year in 1806. Its principal sequence was the Russian entry into the two Danubian principalities in 1806; the Battle of Râmnicu Sărat on 22 September Old Style, equivalent to 4 October New Style; the preliminary Slobozia agreement in December 1807; the collapse of negotiations and resumption of fighting in 1808; the capture of Izmail in Bessarabia in 1809; the Battle of Batin on 19 September 1810; the Russian occupation of Ruse on 7 July 1811 followed by the blockade of Silistra; and the Treaty of Bucharest on 16 May Old Style, or 28 May New Style, in 1812. The main Russian axis of movement ran south from Moldavia through the Târgoviște direction toward Râmnicu Sărat, then toward Giurgiu and Slobozia. Kamensky’s later operations used the Izmail, Hirsova, and Batin line, while the 1811 advance passed from Ruse toward Silistra. Russian infantry regiments were organized around three battalions, each with four companies, and divisions and brigades combined several regiments into formations capable of sustained operations. The Ottoman army combined Nizam-i Cedid regulars with provincial infantry and cavalry, as well as bashibazouks employed for pursuit and disruptive missions, creating substantial differences in cohesion and command. The Russian force at Râmnicu Sărat is commonly estimated at about 19,000 men, against roughly 15,000 Ottomans, though sources use different counting dates. Russian infantry normally carried about sixty rounds per man, with battalion trains carrying reserve ammunition, while artillery batteries sustained fire through limbers and ammunition wagons. Ottoman logistics revolved around Constantinople, Silistra, Ruse, and Danube shipping; when an army camped too far from a supply point, gun ammunition and provisions fell short rapidly. Pontoon bridges, boats, ox carts, and riverside depots determined the speed of river crossings and pursuit. Ice, spring mud, and disease repeatedly halted planned offensives. Surviving records establish the outcome, captures, and direction of retreats at the main actions, but they do not support a single dependable total for casualties on either side.
cause: 直接引爆戰爭的是1805至1806年間俄土談判破裂，以及俄軍進入摩爾多瓦與瓦拉幾亞後，兩國對附屬公國控制權、督軍任命和邊境軍隊的爭執。克里米亞在俄土關係中的地位、黑海航運與商業權利同樣被列入交涉。深層原因是亞歷山大一世希望扭轉1792年《亞斯亞條約》後俄國在比薩拉比亞與多瑙河方向失去的優勢，取得更安全的邊界與外陸基地；奧斯曼則要把多瑙河公國和黑海通道掌握在自己手中，阻止俄軍常駐。1801年保羅一世去世後，俄國不再維持針對法國的舊同盟架構，亞歷山大一世重新採取對南歐擴張的政策，而拿破侖正需要把俄國力量牽制在南方。法國的援助、軍事顧問及英國和瑞典早先對俄國的支持，使奧斯曼在外交上擁有周旋餘地。塞利姆三世整編尼扎姆－傑迪德新軍、削弱禁衛軍權力，又與宗教和地方利益衝突；這些內部矛盾不是條約上的正式交戰理由，卻使奧斯曼的財政、指揮與徵募更難承受持久戰爭。《提爾西特和約》使俄土談判取得更明確的國際框架，卻沒有消除核心利益衝突，反而把停火條件變成雙方都難以接受的問題。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was the breakdown of Russo-Ottoman negotiations between 1805 and 1806, followed by the Russian entry into Moldavia and Wallachia and disputes over control of the principalities, appointment of their hospodars, and the disposition of frontier troops. The position of Crimea in Russo-Ottoman relations, Black Sea navigation, and commercial rights also entered the negotiations. The deeper cause was Alexander I’s intention to reverse Russia’s loss of strategic position in Bessarabia and along the Danube after the 1792 Treaty of Jassy, obtaining a safer frontier and an overland base. The Ottomans sought to retain the Danubian principalities and control of Black Sea access, preventing permanent Russian military presence there. After Paul I’s death in 1801, Russia no longer maintained the previous anti-French alliance structure, and Alexander adopted a more expansionist southern policy. Napoleon needed Russia’s strength tied down in the south. French assistance and military advisers, together with the earlier British and Swedish support for Russia, gave the Ottoman government diplomatic room to maneuver. Selim III’s reorganization of the Nizam-i Cedid and reduction of Janissary power collided with religious and regional interests. These internal disputes were not the formal legal cause of war, but they made Ottoman finances, command, and recruitment less able to sustain a long conflict. The Treaty of Tilsit supplied a clearer international framework for Russo-Ottoman negotiations without resolving the underlying disputes; it instead made the armistice terms difficult for both sides to accept.
impact: 戰爭最深遠的結果出現在多瑙河下游與黑海權力結構。俄國取得比薩拉比亞，取得完整的多瑙河航行權，邊界由普魯特河向東推進；俄軍從此能把克里米亞、烏克蘭南部與新領土連接起來。奧斯曼失去重要緩衝地帶，卻保住瓦拉幾亞、摩爾多瓦及魯塞、錫利斯特拉等要塞，國家並未因此解體。塞爾維亞在蘇丹宗主權下的教會、地方行政與稅收安排得到更明確的確認，也因此更深入地捲入俄奧競爭。軍事上，俄國的標準化步槍、營屬後備彈藥、炮兵集中使用和浮橋體系，使其能反覆把遠征部隊投送到多瑙河；奧斯曼則看見常備線列步兵與炮兵在組織和供應上的差距，尼扎姆－傑迪德新軍在1808年被解散，馬哈茂德二世日後仍須重建改革軍。另一項結果是俄法關係惡化：俄土和約解除多瑙河軍務，使俄國得以集中力量應付拿破侖在1812年的入侵，而奧斯曼則因俄國在巴爾干的影響與塞爾維亞問題，難以長期維持對法、對俄兩面作戰的格局。這是一場重新劃定力量邊界的戰爭，不是任何一方完全勝出的單方面崩解。
impactEn: The war’s deepest consequences appeared in the lower Danube and in the balance of power in the Black Sea. Russia acquired Bessarabia, secured unrestricted navigation rights on the Danube, and moved its frontier eastward to the Prut. It could now connect Crimea and southern Ukraine with the new territory. The Ottomans lost an important buffer but retained Wallachia, Moldavia, and fortresses such as Ruse and Silistra; the state was not thereby dissolved. Serbia’s church, local administration, and fiscal arrangements under Ottoman suzerainty received clearer recognition, drawing the principality more deeply into the Russian-Ottoman rivalry. Militarily, Russia’s standardized muskets, battalion reserve ammunition, concentration of artillery, and pontoon system allowed it to project forces repeatedly into the Danube region. The Ottomans saw the organizational and supply advantages of European-style line infantry and artillery. The Nizam-i Cedid was disbanded in 1808, and Mahmud II later had to rebuild a reformed army. The settlement also worsened Russian relations with France. Ending the Danube commitment released Russian forces for Napoleon’s invasion in 1812, while Russian influence in the Balkans and the Serbian question made it increasingly difficult for the Ottoman government to remain committed to a two-front struggle against both France and Russia. The war redrew the balance of power without producing the complete collapse of either belligerent.
result: 戰爭在1812年5月正式以《布加勒斯特條約》收束。條約確認俄國保有比薩拉比亞及其境內主要要塞，奧斯曼接受以普魯特河作為新的重要邊界；俄軍則從瓦拉幾亞及多瑙河以南的占領區撤出，把魯塞等地交還奧方。條約同時確認塞爾維亞在蘇丹宗主權下的較廣地方自治，並給予俄國一定程度的通商便利。軍事上，俄國取得了有限而實在的領土勝利，卻沒有取得博斯普魯斯與達達尼爾海峽的控制權，也沒有攻入君士坦丁堡；奧斯曼雖失去比薩拉比亞，仍保住巴爾干核心地區，並在戰後重新取得外交與軍事的活動空間。1807年的拉姆尼庫薩拉特、1810年的巴丁與1811年的魯塞先後削弱奧軍士氣和野戰協同，1812年的前線僵局則使雙方都有接受現實邊界的理由。關於傷亡，現存俄軍戰報、奧方命令與外交報告可確認多場戰鬥的退卻、俘獲及傷病潮，卻因疾病死亡、逃亡、重傷與戰俘統計採不同日期和口徑，沒有可信的單一精確總數；因此較可靠的實錄應保留勝負、方向、日期與後果，而不拼接一個表面完整的合計數。
resultEn: The war formally ended with the Treaty of Bucharest in May 1812. The treaty confirmed Russian possession of Bessarabia and its principal fortresses, and the Ottomans accepted the Prut as the new major frontier. Russian forces withdrew from occupied areas in Wallachia and south of the Danube, returning places such as Ruse to Ottoman control. It also recognized wider local autonomy for Serbia under Ottoman suzerainty and granted Russia a degree of commercial convenience. Militarily, Russia achieved a limited but real territorial victory without gaining control of the Bosporus and Dardanelles or reaching Constantinople. The Ottomans lost Bessarabia but preserved their essential Balkan territories and regained room for diplomatic and military action after the war. The sequence of Râmnicu Sărat in 1807, Batin in 1810, and Ruse in 1811 had already damaged Ottoman morale and battlefield cooperation, while the stalemate of 1812 gave both governments reasons to accept a settlement based on existing realities. On casualties, surviving Russian reports, Ottoman orders, and diplomatic accounts establish retreats, captures, and outbreaks of disease at many actions, but they do not provide a single dependable total because deaths from disease, desertions, severe wounds, and prisoners were recorded at different times and under different definitions. A reliable chronicle therefore preserves outcomes, directions, dates, and consequences rather than assembling an apparently precise combined casualty figure from incompatible records.
